title: Seasonality, range, and morphology of bluebottles (Physalia) around the world's oceans: code, data, and figures
description:
Code, data, and figures accompanying the manuscript. This archive is the analysis half of an identification and monitoring toolkit for the five described Physalia species; the sequence data live in GenBank and the SRA, and are linked from this record.

Contains:

  • A labelled iNaturalist dataset of 20,704 observations, each with photo URL, licence, attribution, species label, and label provenance. The photographs themselves are not redistributed — their licences vary per observation — but the corpus can be reassembled from this table.
  • R code for the seasonal abundance, observer-effort normalisation, mapping, and classification analyses.
  • Gene alignments and maximum-likelihood trees for 16S, 18S, CO1, and ITS, plus whole mitochondrial genome alignments and trees, with tip metadata. These are the reference panels for molecular identification.
  • Snakemake workflows for read quality control and mitochondrial genome assembly, for both Illumina and Oxford Nanopore libraries.
  • Python code for the image classification model. The fitted model is not included.
  • Manuscript and supplementary figure sources.
